The report is saved to PostgreSQL

now.title: What I'm building now
now.lead: GreenCare is an AI platform for running golf courses. Greenkeepers photograph turf on their phones, mark work zones on the course map and get a disease analysis back in seconds. I lead its design and development across mobile, admin and backend.

steps.title: Capture
steps.text: A field worker photographs the turf. The app tags the photo with GPS and the hole it belongs to.

steps.title: Analyze
steps.text: Gemini Vision reads the image and returns the likely disease, its severity and a confidence score.

steps.title: Assign
steps.text: The finding becomes a work zone on the course map, with a task for the right crew.

steps.title: Track
steps.text: Managers follow progress, inventory and purchasing from the admin, course by course.

points: Lead design and development of GreenCare: turf-disease detection with Gemini Vision and an end-to-end image, analysis and report pipeline.
Built the React Native field app, React admin and FastAPI/PostgreSQL backend, including GPS task tracking, course maps, inventory and purchasing.
Rebuilt the legacy PHP/MySQL company website and admin in Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma and PostgreSQL, in Korean, English, Chinese and Japanese, with roles, a CMS and a full data migration.
items.stack: React Native, React, Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Gemini Vision

points: Built models for luxury-goods authentication and resale price prediction across brands like Gucci, Louis Vuitton and Chanel.
Detected counterfeits with part-level image classification and segmentation, trained on about 140,000 curated images.
Integrated the models into web apps for real-time decision support.
Built a crack-data visualization tool for structural engineering analysis.
Rendered interactive 3D engineering models in the browser with Three.js and React Three Fiber.
Built a Next.js file management system with MobX state, and trained ML models on engineering data. Started as an intern.
